candidates.body: In `packages/bruno-cli/src/runner/interpolate-vars.js`, `interpolateVars` builds the lookup with `Object.assign({}, params)`, so a path parameter named `__proto__` silently vanishes: the assignment writes to the prototype instead of creating the key, and `{{__proto__}}` renders the stringified Object.prototype. Use a null-prototype map (`Object.create(null)`) or a `Map` here.
